name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the viewport, for filters, details and secondary tasks that keep the page in context.

examples.description: Fields in a scrollable body with actions pinned to the bottom.

examples.description: start, end, top and bottom. start and end are logical and swap in right-to-left layouts.

props.description: Edge the panel is attached to. end is the right edge in LTR and the left edge in RTL.

props.description: Heading; also the panel's accessible name.

notes: A modal dialog (role="dialog") named by its title; the page behind is inert while it is open.

Overlays render in a portal on <body>, outside any ThemeScope. When it opens, the overlay looks up data-strata-theme, data-strata-scheme, data-strata-density, dir and lang — each on the nearest ancestor that has it — starting from its trigger (or from where the component is rendered, when controlled), and copies them onto its own root — so it uses the same tenant tokens and direction as the page region it came from, and nested overlays inherit from their parent overlay.
Right-to-left: give the ThemeScope a locale (e.g. locale="ar-AE"), which sets dir and wraps React Aria's I18nProvider, so arrow keys and start/end placement flip as well as the layout.

The backdrop blurs the page lightly and dims it with backdrop-filter: brightness(0.6), so it recedes in light and dark schemes alike. The panel is glass (--strata-glass-bg + backdrop blur); only text.default and text.subtle sit directly on it, the two roles the theme engine solves to 4.5:1 over any backdrop.
Motion: the panel slides in from its side (start/end follow the reading direction) and leaves faster than it came. With prefers-reduced-motion it appears without moving.

do: Use end for detail and filter panels, bottom for short mobile actions.
Keep the primary action in the footer so it stays visible while the body scrolls.
dont: Don't use a sheet for navigation that should stay visible — use a persistent sidebar.
